A/B test.summary: An A/B test compares two or more design variants with live users to measure which one improves a predefined product metric.
A/B test.problem: A/B tests that start from visual preference can overfit clicks, miss trust damage, or stop before the result is stable.
A/B test.mechanics: Write the hypothesis, define the audience and allocation, instrument the primary conversion plus guardrails, run to the planned sample, and decide before peeking at noisy results.
A/B test.tradeoffs: Experiments give production evidence, but they need traffic, analytics quality, and ethical guardrails for manipulative variants.
A/B test.troubleshoot: If results look surprising, check event instrumentation, sample ratio mismatch, segment imbalance, seasonality, and whether users were exposed to both variants.
A/B test.example: Experiment brief: Variant B shortens signup copy; primary metric activation within 24h; guardrails unsubscribe rate and support tickets; stop after 14 days or planned sample. Evidence cue: An A/B test compares two or more design variants with live users to measure which one improves a predefined product metric.
A/B test.integration: 1) Write hypothesis and decision rule 2) Instrument primary and guardrail metrics 3) Run with stable allocation 4) Ship, iterate, or stop based on result.

AI-assisted design.integration: 1) Map the target task 2) Sketch or prototype key states 3) Review hierarchy and accessibility 4) Validate the risky step.

Auto Layout.summary: Auto Layout is Figma behavior that lets frames and components resize predictably from padding, spacing, direction, and constraints.
Auto Layout.problem: Poor Auto Layout makes components break with long labels, translated text, or different screen widths.
Auto Layout.mechanics: Set direction, gap, padding, hug/fill rules, min/max widths, and nested frames so the component resizes from content rather than manual pixel nudges.
Auto Layout.tradeoffs: Auto Layout speeds responsive work, but deeply nested frames can confuse contributors and should be named clearly.
Auto Layout.troubleshoot: If a component collapses, inspect hug/fill settings, absolute positioning, fixed widths, text wrapping, and nested frame constraints.
Auto Layout.example: Figma button: horizontal Auto Layout, 12px left/right padding, 8px icon gap, label hugs contents, container min-height 44px, loading spinner variant keeps width stable. Evidence cue: Auto Layout is Figma behavior that lets frames and components resize predictably from padding, spacing, direction, and constraints.
Auto Layout.integration: 1) Set padding, gap, and direction 2) Define hug/fill behavior for content 3) Test long text and responsive widths 4) Document component resizing rules.

WCAG.summary: WCAG is the W3C accessibility standard of testable success criteria organized around perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust experiences.

WCAG.mechanics: Evaluate WCAG at component and journey level: inspect semantics, measure target or contrast values, keyboard through the flow, and confirm error/status announcements when relevant.
WCAG.tradeoffs: Accessibility constraints can challenge brand or density preferences, but they usually improve clarity, error recovery, and usability for all users.
WCAG.troubleshoot: When WCAG fails, check token values, component semantics, focus management, disabled-state contrast, viewport size, and whether the issue repeats across the design system.
WCAG.example: Accessibility audit: verify WCAG on login and checkout with keyboard-only navigation, visible focus, label association, and documented WCAG criterion. Evidence cue: WCAG is the W3C accessibility standard of testable success criteria organized around perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust experiences.
WCAG.integration: 1) Map WCAG to WCAG or platform guidance 2) Fix the source component or token 3) Test keyboard, screen reader, and pointer behavior 4) Track defects by user impact.

affinity mapping.tradeoffs: affinity mapping gives depth and context, but it may not estimate frequency; pair it with analytics or survey data when scale matters.
affinity mapping.troubleshoot: If affinity mapping findings conflict, review recruiting, moderator wording, task realism, prototype fidelity, and whether outliers were over-weighted.
affinity mapping.example: Research artifact: affinity mapping plan with objective, participant criteria, task/script, note grid, severity tags, clips/quotes, and decision recommendations.
